question: In a certain code language, ‘ORGAN’ is written as ‘QWDLC’ and ‘OPERATE’ is written as ‘QBXWLSX’. How will ‘GENERATOR’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**The pattern followed here is : A certain code is assigned to each letter without any specific pattern.**

So,

 
• ORGAN is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4000ff84e59fd89f0b361505a53af374045a3018a210e0ea6afded3ebc718c5b.png] ​

 
• OPERATE is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86126799e1bd995caf9d55048dfa87eef8f82a6a9a5a51c804ed7e795b8a0ca5.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• GENERATOR is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6228c2ca15df557953e567bf4572b0a5688ad0957976967cfbceb82e561fc100.png] ​

As, from the given codes the common letters have same code, therefore each letter is given a certain code accordingly.

Hence, **"****DXCXWLSQW"** is the correct answer.

8a:T
